actions.findings:
Biological and non-equilibrium chemical patterns maintain persistence across generations by inheriting contingent features from prior states. [source-42166355dfaa4050]

Algebraic conditions on stoichiometric submatrices define bipartite König subgraphs that support irreducible autocatalytic networks. [peer-0592c13110957d2468eeda39]

Thermodynamic frameworks link non-equilibrium persistence in prebiotic reaction networks directly to the emergence of natural selection. [peer-c968e2b146d17f805757c57c]
actions.limitations: Direct experimental confirmation across complex multi-phase abiotic networks remains incomplete; stoichiometric submatrix conditions are derived primarily within idealized continuous-flow models.
actions.next_questions: What exact free-energy dissipation thresholds differentiate passive dynamical hysteresis from genuine heritable transmission?
